name: O Pedrouzo to Santiago de Compostela
notes: Santiago de Compostela is the place=city node in the old town (node 998649870), 0.1 km from the cathedral point used in supabase/seed.sql (42.8806,-8.5446); Photon lists the municipality relation first (centroid 42.90646,-8.51930, 3.6 km north-east), which was not used. O Monte do Gozo is tagged place=locality (the hill with the pilgrim hostel); San Marcos and San Paio are on the Camino but were not looked up. O Amenal has a second OSM object tagged place=neighbourhood 0.3 km away; the hamlet node is used.
